authorization: User asked to learn from a sample of their answers and extrapolate to assist review, replacing any expectation of manually reviewing 718 records.
learning_method: Use actual teaching answers and reasons to propose explicit fact-extraction/routing rules; preserve conflicting answers for adjudication. Freeze revisions before revealing separate check answers.
score_policy: No inherited v2 scores; confidence remains uncalibrated. Do not turn a handful of labels into percentage probabilities or a certification threshold.
selection: Deterministic family-balanced selection of original source controls only, from filings dated <=2015-12-31; separate check picked first, then teaching. Group by historical issuer CIK across all its filings. Prior human-exposed issuers excluded from separate checks; no ranking on parser confidence, predicted class or outcomes.
shortfalls: Keep explicit shortfalls; no future-period substitutes, source replacements or automatic workload increase.
validation_scope: A small separate development check, not a clean final holdout. All original pilot sources were previously exposed during AI development. Short fact questions assess their displayed scope, not full-source event absence or recall.
after_check_failure: Report failure, retain uncertainty; if reused for teaching, mark that check spent and require a newly registered future evaluation before any generalization claim.
uncertainty_route: Always unresolved/review-required for missing authority, conflict, prior baseline, ownership scope or public timing; user interpretation cannot manufacture missing evidence.
